title: BeyondSight: Object Permanence for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: BeyondSight decouples actor existence from instantaneous observability, propagates persistent actor hypotheses through occlusion, and evaluates visible and unobservable actors separately.

mechanisms.name: Existence-observability decoupling
mechanisms.description: Maintain an actor-existence hypothesis across temporary invisibility while updating it with observation-conditioned evidence and reporting performance separately for observable and unobservable actors.
mechanisms.limitations: Automotive end-to-end results and nuScenes-Permanence supervision do not establish that an unseen actor exists in wearable DTR, that a lineage is correct, or that a retained hypothesis is calibrated collision risk.
